target.title: fix(acp): guard child process pipe stream errors in createAcpClient
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`createAcpClient` spawns an ACP server with `stdio: ["pipe", "pipe", "inherit"]` but registered no `error` listeners on the child stdout, stdin, or process. An EPIPE or stream error on either pipe would trigger an unhandled `error` event, crashing the host Node process.

## Why This Change Was Made

Added three `on("error")` handlers in `createAcpClient`:
- `agent.stdout.on("error", …)` — stdout read pipe
- `agent.stdin.on("error", …)` — stdin write pipe
- `agent.on("error", …)` — spawn-level failures

Same pattern as grep.ts (#101014), find.ts, bash tool, ssh sandbox. Exported `createAcpClient` via a `testing` namespace (#101749 conventions) so production-path tests can exercise the handlers.

## User Impact

No behavioral change for normal ACP sessions. Stream errors now log to stderr (in verbose mode) instead of crashing the gateway.

## Evidence

### Real process proof — spawned child processes, triggered EPIPE, host survived

```
$ node outputs/issue-102047/live-acp-proof.mjs

Test 1: Kill child → EPIPE on pipe (WITH handler, matches client.ts:155-159)
  Process survived — no crash. ✓

Test 2: Simultaneous stdout+stdin EPIPE → both caught
  [stdout] stdout EPIPE
  [stdin] stdin EPIPE
  Both caught (2), process survived. ✓

Test 3: Process-level error (ENOENT) → caught, no crash
  [process] spawn /nonexistent/binary ENOENT
  ENOENT caught: true, host survived. ✓

All 3 live tests passed
```

Without the error handlers from this PR, each test would crash the Node process with `Unhandled 'error' event`.

### Production-path tests — calls createAcpClient, emits errors on its pipes

```
 ✓ registers error handler on stdout through createAcpClient
 ✓ registers error handler on stdin through createAcpClient
 ✓ registers error handler on child process through createAcpClient
 ✓ handles simultaneous stdout+stdin errors through createAcpClient
 ✓ negative control: PassThrough without error listener throws

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  5 passed (5)
```

### Production handler locations

```
src/acp/client.ts:157:  agent.stdout.on("error", (err) => onStreamError("stdout", err));
src/acp/client.ts:158:  agent.stdin.on("error", (err) => onStreamError("stdin", err));
src/acp/client.ts:159:  agent.on("error", (err) => onStreamError("spawn", err));
```
